entries.label: Year Plan

entries.description: View and manage the organization's annual plan, activities by sub-department, and planned months.

entries.label: Year Plan (informational)
entries.menu_path: N/A — conceptual
entries.description: The year plan lists annual activities by sub-department and month. Staff see planned activities linked to their sub-department in monthly reports and the weekly matrix. Only users with manage year plans permission can edit it under Sidebar > Year Plan.

entries.label: Weekly Matrix
entries.menu_path: Sidebar > Weekly Matrix
entries.description: View and edit weekly matrix grids by work period. Each sub-department records key activities, outputs, outcomes, impact, and links to year plan activities.

entries.label: Weekly Matrix impact (informational)
entries.menu_path: Sidebar > Weekly Matrix
entries.description: The Impact column in the weekly matrix captures the effect or change resulting from the week's work. Outcomes describe results; impact explains why they matter. Link entries to year plan activities to show alignment with the annual plan.
intents: what is impact in weekly matrix

entries.label: Assigned tasks (informational)
entries.menu_path: Dashboard or Weekly Plans
entries.description: Staff can receive tasks in two ways: weekly plan activities assigned by teammates when someone adds them as a team member on a plan, and action log follow-up tasks from meetings. Assigned weekly activities appear on the dashboard and on the assignee's weekly plan page. Action log tasks are tracked under Sidebar > Activities > Weekly Activities > Action Log.
intents: what tasks are assigned to me

entries.label: Weekly plan vs weekly report (informational)
entries.menu_path: N/A — conceptual
entries.description: A weekly plan sets intentions for the upcoming week; a weekly report records what was done during a completed week. Plans are submitted before the week; reports after. Monthly reports summarize progress against year plan activities for the month.
intents: difference between weekly plan and weekly report
